subject: Re: DVRL status: corrupted-sample numbers in, domain adaptation lagging
body:
Team,

Decision from yesterday's review: we're cutting the image transfer-learning application from v1 entirely, not just deprioritizing it. The LRB pre-read goes in with data valuation and corrupted-sample discovery as the launch scope, domain adaptation as a fast-follow once Wei's seed-variance issue is under 1.5 points.

Rationale: the demo landed well (the 87%-at-20%-noise number did the work), and the feedback was uniformly "ship the tabular story first." Adding an image pipeline now buys us risk, not signal.

Deshawn - please rebalance Gustavo toward hardening the data tooling for pilot customers, and keep Rosa on the eval harness through the Aug 3 decision point. I'll draft the LRB doc this week and circulate for comments by Friday.

Good work everyone, this one's in decent shape.

Lucia
